related_context: This GET endpoint is registered with a shipmentId path parameter. The injected findShipment function performs the lookup and returns either a Shipment or null. A blank parameter produces a 400 response, an absent record produces a 404 response, and unexpected repository failures are delegated to the framework error middleware. The response adapter has status and json methods. Unit tests use Vitest and call the handler directly.

The handler is mounted on the reservation creation route as a POST endpoint. It receives a parsed request body and uses the injected createReservation service; persistence and reservation policy are owned by that service. The response adapter exposes status and json methods, and unexpected service errors are passed to the framework error middleware through next. Tests use Vitest and invoke the handler directly with lightweight request and response objects.

This PATCH endpoint adjusts inventory for the SKU in the path. The request body supplies an integer delta and the version the client last observed. The injected adjustStock operation applies the update atomically, returns null for an unknown SKU, and may throw InsufficientStockError or VersionConflictError. The handler maps those business conflicts to 409 responses, uses 400 for malformed input and 404 for an unknown item, and forwards other errors to framework middleware. Tests use Vitest with direct handler invocation.
